text:
maya: heads-up — canary batcher rollout is showing a regression on the sm-serve pools. token/sec down ~25-30%, queueing delay up. holding the rollout. :eyes:

infra-bot: [perf-alert] PR 1457 merged -> canary 2026-03-10 08:22Z. metric: tokens/s (baseline=4350, canary=3200) | p50 latency +18% | queue depth +45%.

alex: noted. last big change in that PR was the new continuous-batching heuristic and the 'min_batch_fill_ms' tuning. suspect it's causing smaller batches and higher overhead.

jon: I repro'd locally with load harness. Batch size distribution shifted right *toward smaller sizes* intermittently. Also saw KV cache hit rate drop ~6% which amplifies token/sec loss. snippet from profiler:```
Scheduler wait histogram (ms): 0-1: 12% | 1-5: 58% | 5-20: 25% | >20: 5%
Batch size distribution: mean=6.3 -> 4.1 (canary) | p95 small batches=72%
KV cache hit: baseline=91.2% | canary=85.1%
Token/s: baseline=4300 | canary=3180
```

maya: thanks jon — can you paste exact commands to repro? we'll need a bisect plan.

jon: run this:```bash
./tools/run_load_test --model=gptx-6b --seq=1024 --concurrency=48 --duration=300 \
  --record-metrics scheduler,kv_cache,batcher
```
Then compare `metrics/batcher_hist.csv` and `metrics/kv_hits.csv`. For quick bisect: `git bisect start -- bad=HEAD good=origin/main~5` then test with a short 60s run.

alex: PR 1457 diff excerpt that touched scheduler:```diff
- if (batch_fill_ms < dynamic_target) adjust_fast();
+ if (batch_fill_ms <= dynamic_target) adjust_fast(); // changed equality case handling
```
This small change could flip edge cases where single-request batches get scheduled earlier.

sre-kate: can we toggle the feature flag to revert heuristic without full revert? We need a short mitigation while we bisect.

dennis: I pushed toggle `continuous_batching_v2=false` to canary config and restarted the pool. Monitoring now. If toggling fixes it we avoid rolling back the whole PR.

infra-bot: config-change: continuous_batching_v2 set to false in canary cluster by dennis.

maya: awesome. dennis, keep watch for 5-10min and post updated token/s and queue depths. jon, proceed with bisect if toggling doesn't fully restore. alex, prepare a minimal revert patch if needed.

dennis: first 3min after toggle: token/s -> 4260 (was 3210), p50 latency back to baseline, queue depth down 40%. Looks promising. :thumbsup:

alex: great signal — sounds like the heuristic equality tweak is the likely culprit. we'll open a targeted revert + unit test for the edge case.

jon: I'll run bisect to confirm and gather flamegraph for the scheduler loop. If anyone needs the raw traces: /mnt/artifacts/1764127890_bisect.tar.gz

maya: thanks team. plan: keep canary toggled off, block rollout until revert lands and CI perf checks pass. post updates here. :lock:
